receipt.public_excerpt: Contextual calibration improves accuracy across a range of tasks.

evidence_items.explanation: Using the uncalibrated eight-shot baseline columns, GPT-3 175B scores 79.1% on AGNews, 95.6% on SST-2, and 63.8% on LAMA; the corresponding GPT-2 results in e2 are 57.1%, 54.5%, and 42.5%. These matched comparisons support broad gains across classification and factual retrieval; the quoted caption describes the study's main intervention, but this comparison uses its baseline results.

evidence_items.locator: Appendix A, Table 4, zero-shot baseline columns; compare Table 1 in e1

receipt.public_excerpt: This table is analogous to Table 1 but shows results for GPT-2 XL.

evidence_items.explanation: The uncalibrated zero-shot baseline scores GPT-2 at 64.3% on DBPedia and 44.6% on CB, versus GPT-3 175B at 22.0% and 30.4% in e1. These exceptions contradict an unrestricted claim of higher observed correctness in every setting, while the same table supplies the GPT-2 baselines supporting broad gains.
